I01.summary: The SBCL terminal emitter uses different ANSI update segmentation and teardown sequences while preserving terminal-state semantics.

I02.summary: Terminal crash frames omit parameter values and local variables. The full backtrace, parameters included, is written only to the mode-0600 private crash log.

I06.summary: SBCL and Node crash-page stack frames differ in function names and source locations. Lines whose visible text begins with four spaces and at are normalized to one <FRAME> line before comparison.

I03.summary: Cadr shares through its own cadr.dev session viewer while the fixed pi baseline links to pi.dev; gist storage and the visible Share URL/Gist contract remain unchanged.

I04.summary: The user-approved Goal 16 product identity replaces pi names, commands, configuration paths, and repository links with their Cadr counterparts.

I05.summary: Login-cancel only (textCovering). User-approved goal 13 ruling: cancelling /login is a normal user action and must not produce error-level output. pi v1.4.0 (4a080252f) regressed this path: packages/coding-agent/src/utils/abort.ts:3 throws Error('The operation was aborted'), while packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:5666 only suppresses errorMsg === 'Login cancelled', so Escape-cancel of OAuth/device-code/loopback/API-key login now renders a red 'Error: Failed to login to ... / Failed to save API key for ...: This operation was aborted' line. cadr keeps the approved suppression (docs/open-questions.md OQ-G18-AUTH-CANCEL-14). Retires when the upstream regression is fixed; then reverts to byte-for-byte alignment.
